items.claim: average() divides by len(prices) with no empty-list guard, so it raises ZeroDivisionError for an empty cart.
items.consequence: The docstring and PR description both say carts are often empty right after creation. average([]) evaluates total([]) / 0, which raises ZeroDivisionError. The new cart summary panel would crash on any freshly created cart. The function needs to return a defined value for empty input, such as 0.0, or the caller needs to handle the empty case explicitly.
